PsOW9x2sOKY.description:
Jake Paul sits down with President Donald Trump for a rare and exclusive interview.

I recently had the opportunity to sit down with President Donald Trump for a brief but wide-ranging conversation. With only around 30 minutes together, we covered a number of topics, including my boxing journey and the lessons I learned from my fight with Anthony Joshua, where I suffered a broken jaw, as well as what may come next in my career. 

President Trump also reflected on key moments from his own life, including surviving the assassination attempt, why he first decided to run for president, and the advice he has for young people striving to succeed. 

We also discussed competition, the mindset behind winning, who the better boxer might be between Logan and I, how he connected with the youth, and the ongoing situation in the Middle East, including the tensions involving Iran.

Thank you to President Trump for taking the time to have this conversation and for sharing his experiences, leadership, and perspective.

1XpCfxBSaUo.description:
Thank you to the families and students of Parkland for redefining what love, courage, and unwavering strength truly is.

I will be forever changed by my experience in Parkland and cannot possibly express the gratitude I have for the wonderful families we met, who took the time to welcome us into their lives and properly educate us about how to most effectively be part of the solution.

In my humble and respectful opinion, without a balanced and actionable approach to gun reform, mental health awareness, effective bullying solutions, school safety measures, truly teaching our youth and adults how to be more mindful and empathetic, better communitywide communication and reporting, etc., we simply cannot effectively correct the current course we're on. 

I vow to be part of the solution and utilize my platform to raise awareness and action across the board, but we cannot focus on one issue, we must actively discuss and make progress on them all.

- Jake Paul

* If you would like to donate to the students and families of Parkland, we were directed by the families we connected with to the following fund:

Broward Education Foundation –  https://www.gofundme.com/stonemandouglasvictimsfund 
* Make sure it says Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School
Or a check can be written and mailed to:
Broward Education Foundation (make sure it is earmarked for Marjory Stoneman Douglas)
600 S.E. 3rd Avenue Fort Lauderdale, Florida 33301 

* There are several wonderful funds setup at the link below; however, we have been told to remind everyone to do their due diligence when choosing a fund to support.

https://www.gofundme.com/mvc.php?route=category&term=Broward%20Education%20Foundation

* A Very Special Thank You to the Blank family for all of your authenticity, hospitality, wisdom, and guidance. Melissa was truly a mom to us and JB will be a friend forever.

The following individuals were not only exceptional teachers and guides during our time in Parkland and beyond, but also became a part of our extended family. Thank you for the wisdom and direction; we will be forever changed because of you and your efforts:

In order of appearance:

Melissa Blank
Jonathan “JB” Blank
Ethan Rocha
Senator Marco Rubio
Councilman Michael Udine
Lexi Udine
Mackenzie and Meghan Hill
Kyle Kashuv
Tanai Bernard
Dezmond Floyd

Due to the message and purpose this video serves, it has not been monetized.
